The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
September 22, 2015. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the
Council with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person
must ask the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item
from the Consent Calendar for discussion.

unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action

minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO

  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  September 2, 2015
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Beall, King, Adams, Vice-Chair Leach, and
  Chairman Buss present.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
   None

OLD BUSINESS

    None

NEW BUSINESS

1. 945 Granvia Altamira Request for Edge Line Striping.

  Traffic Safety Committee Member King moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  Member Beall) to recommend the implementation of the reconfiguration of the centerline
  striping on Granvia Altamira. The existing left-turn lane at Via Panorama is not required
  and not followed by through traffic. The additional cost involved for the additional white
  edge line along the north/east side of Granvia Altamira is minimal and will provide a
  continuation of the edge line south of the Via Panorama intersection in addition to
  providing the requested marked area outside the travel lane on Granvia Altamira. (5-0 in
  favor)

2. Request for a Convex Driveway Mirror at 812 Via Del Monte.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on September 22, 2015.

Traffic Safety Committee  1  Planning & Building Director SR-L
Action Memo
September 2, 2015
   Traffic Safety Committee Vice-Chair Leach moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  Member Adams) to 1) Trim the trees along the south side of the street as needed to maintain
  adequate sight distances along Via Del Monte; 2) Install a warning sign approximately 200
  feet west of the Paseo Del Sol intersection alerting drivers of the presence of driveways
  ahead; and 3) To address speeding on Via Del Monte by repositioning two of the radar
  feedback speed signs on Via Del Monte near the 812 address for a period of time. Traffic
  Committee Member Chairman Buss requested staff address placement of unauthorized
  convex mirror on nearby property. (5-0 in favor)

3. Red Curb at Via Amador and Avenida Mirola Intersection.

  Traffic Committee Member Vice-Chair Leach moved (seconded by Traffic Safety
  Committee Member King) to approve recommendations 1 and 3 to prune the trees and
  bushes along the south curb of Via Amador to provide clear sight lines and to paint the curb
  along the south side of Via Amador red from the street name sign post to the west side of
  the storm drain inlet. (5-0 in favor)

4. On-Street Vehicle Sales on Paseo Lunado near Palos Verdes Drive West.

  Traffic Safety Committee Chairman Buss moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  Member King) to recommend staff to conduct a poll amongst the residents and further
  study the location. (5-0 in favor)

5. Draft Engineering and Traffic Safety Committee Work Plan.

  Accepted

6. None.
